{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America emphatically and unreservedly opposes a U.S. war on Iran.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A U.S. war on Iran would be another “war of choice,” like the Iraq War of 2003.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A U.S. war on Iran would likely be a colossal humanitarian disaster.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"National security adviser John Bolton works closely with the Mujahedeen Khalq (MEK).",

"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Mujahedeen Khalq (MEK) receives U.S. funding.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"John Bolton has been urging an attack on Iran for many years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Mike Pompeo, Secretary of State, pushed hardest for crippling sanctions on Iran.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As a result of the sanctions, the value of Iran’s currency has plummeted.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The sanctions have led to shortages of imported goods and products that are made with raw materials from abroad.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The sanctions have caused a dramatic increase in living costs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. sanctions are preventing Iranians from access to life-saving medicines.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. sanctions are contributing to record-high youth unemployment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump came very close to striking Iran after Iran shot down a U.S. military drone.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Iran claimed the U.S. military drone was on a spy mission over its territory.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A general told Donald Trump that a “disproportionate” 150 Iranians would likely die in the attack.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump’s plans to deploy 1,000 more soldiers, Patriot missiles and manned and unmanned surveillance aircraft to the region have not been rescinded.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump’s plans to deploy an additional 1,500 soldiers after the May tanker attacks have not been rescinded.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
